purpose: Question strings and EXPECTATIONS only. No production answer payload, no monetary total and no row from any book is recorded here. Every expectation is either a safety class the product must honour on any governed book, or an identity between two live responses that stays true when the portfolio changes. A book that lacks a field must be free to refuse: refusal for a DATA reason is reported, never failed.

expectation_types.MUST_ANSWER: any governed book can answer this; a semantic refusal is a failure
expectation_types.MUST_REFUSE: names something no governed vocabulary claims, in a position where a restriction goes; a figure here is a silent wrong answer
expectation_types.MAY_REFUSE_FOR_DATA: needs a field not every book carries; scored fully if answered, reported as data if refused
expectation_types.EQUAL_TO: same population AND same measure fingerprint
expectation_types.SAME_RESULT_AS: same population, same measure fingerprint, same group keys and per-group values
expectation_types.SAME_POPULATION_AS: same population size; the measures may legitimately differ
expectation_types.SUBSET_OF: the narrowed population never exceeds the population it narrows
expectation_types.ATOMIC_EQUIVALENCE: a composed restriction equals the same restrictions composed in another order
expectation_types.OUTPUT_COMPLETENESS: every output the question asked for is present in the response
expectation_types.GROUPING_RECONCILIATION: the parts of a partition sum to the whole, computed from this run only
